title: Best Egg Financial Health platform data breach, Nov 2026

subject.name: Best Egg
subject.about: Best Egg is a US consumer finance company that offers personal loans and tools to help people manage their money. It says it has funded 2.9 million loans.

also_called: the Best Egg Financial Health breach
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Best Egg, Barclays, Experian, any state attorney general, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Best Egg lends to people across the US, and American Banker reports about 792,000 records affected; Best Egg's own notice gives no total. Texas alone lists 74,013 Texans.
who_is_affected: People whose information was on Best Egg's Financial Health platform, including borrowers and some who never took a loan. Those affected are being sent letters with a code for 24 months of free credit monitoring.

known.text: Best Egg says an unauthorized third party got into its Financial Health platform on Oct 25-26, 2026, and took records.
The records include names, dates of birth, Social Security numbers and the account numbers people use to pay their Best Egg loans.
The Texas Attorney General lists 74,013 Texans affected.
Best Egg offers 24 months of free Experian credit monitoring, with enrolment open until March 31, 2027.

not_known.text: How the intruder got in, and who it was.
The exact total of people affected in a filing we could read; American Banker reports about 792,000 records.
